title: Knowledge Base
subtitle: Manage FAQ entries and hotel information that the AI chatbot uses to answer guest questions automatically.
create_subtitle: Add a question, policy, or information for the AI to use when answering guests.
activate_desc: The AI will start using this entry to answer guest questions.
activated: Entry activated — AI can now use this.
deactivated: Entry deactivated — AI will skip this.
deactivate_desc: The AI will no longer use this entry to answer guest questions.
content_placeholder: e.g. Check-in time is at 2:00 PM. Early check-in is available upon request.
category_hint: Group this entry by topic so the AI can find it faster.
title_hint: The topic or question a guest might ask about.
content_hint: The information the AI should use to answer. Be specific and accurate.
priority_hint: Higher priority entries are preferred by the AI when multiple entries match.
status_hint: Only active entries are used by the AI.
delete_desc: This entry will be permanently removed. The AI will no longer use this information.
empty_desc: Start adding FAQ entries, hotel policies, and room information so the AI chatbot can answer guest questions accurately.
no_results_desc: Try adjusting your search or filters.
error_desc: Could not load knowledge base entries. The backend API may not be available yet.
